Container.Name: lab-notebook
Container.Overview:
Self-hosted lab notebook for organic chemistry experiments. Plan experiments with a reagent table that fills in molar masses, densities, boiling and melting points and GHS hazards from PubChem Local, calculates mass, volume, mmol, equivalents, the limiting reagent and the yield, keeps a timestamped log of observations and measurements, and generates the lab report as PDF, Markdown or a printable page.
Requires the PubChem Local container (ghcr.io/mcaragon/local_pubchem_db) for chemical data; without it, all data can be entered by hand.
Container.Requires: PubChem Local (pubchem-local container) for chemical data lookups.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Notebook database (notebook.sqlite). Back this folder up.

Config.Name: PubChem Local URL
Config.Description: Base URL of PubChem Local as seen from this container. On the default bridge network: http://UNRAID-IP:55055 (Unraid IP + host port). Only if both containers are on the same custom Docker network: http://pubchem-local:8080 (container name + container port); names do not resolve on the default bridge network.

Config.Name: Author
Config.Description: Default author name for new experiments and reports.

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Time zone for log timestamps, e.g. Europe/Berlin. Unraid normally sets this automatically.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as
